Paragraph: "Look at those mountain caves, Lakshmana! They echo with the calls of peacocks, sounding like vast halls of music..."
Situation/Problem_Faced: Observing mountain caves amplifying bird sounds into orchestral echoes.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Rama compares mountain acoustics to grand musical chambers.
Outcome/Resolution: He appreciates the natural majesty of the cavernous landscape.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Guha (The cave as a sacred, quiet space echoing divine sound)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Caves echoing with natural sound symbolize the heart (Guha) echoing with sacred truths.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Finding majestic and grand interpretations of natural geography to uplift the spirit.
